spans.s: तु (1) short term ( प्रत्याहार ) for the dental consonants त्, थ्, द्, ध् and न् cf.

; (2) personal-end- ing substituted for ति in the 2nd pers. imper. sing. Parasmaipada cf. P. III, 4.86; (3) tad. affix तु in the sense of possession added in Vedic Literature to कम् and शम् e. g. क्रन्तुः, शन्तु: cf.
; (4) unadi affix तु ( तुन्) prescribed by the rule सितनिगमिमसिसच्यविधाञ्कुशि- भ्यस्तुन् ( Unadi Sitra
) before which the augment इ is not added e.g. सेतुः सक्तुः etc. cf.
